title: DX11 MapBuffer shadow copy must be scoped to ConstantBuffer only
content: The initial fix for WC memory read-back (shadow copy for DYNAMIC buffers) was too broad — it applied to ALL DYNAMIC Upload buffers including vertex buffers. Vertex buffers need data written directly to the GPU buffer via MAP_WRITE_DISCARD; the shadow copy data never reached the GPU, causing overlay vertices to be all zeros (stats overlay invisible). Fix: restrict shadow copy path to ConstantBuffer usage only. Vertex/index/structured buffers use direct MAP_WRITE_DISCARD into the GPU buffer.
